notes: UNSURE, REVIEW. Opened May 26, 2026 release: dosing complete (99 patients), topline expected Q2 2027, no figures given. But the company issued repeated 'positive preliminary blinded data' releases in 2025 (snippets: e.g. 'over 70% report major pain and function improvement', '52% >=50% pain and function gain in 25 patients'). These are pooled blinded, not randomized-arm comparisons, so I judged them not to be a result of the randomized comparison; I did not open them. A reviewer may wish to decide whether they count as a vague statement on the primary efficacy outcome.
